burst_acquisition.framing: FPGA finds synchronization and parses packets/CRC from raw data. Earliest uncertain pretrigger rows may be flagged invalid; required useful start and any shortened preamble must remain in recorded history. Bit/event boundary follows final partial word. Buffer overflow drops burst and reports failure, never wraps into apparently valid data.
burst_acquisition.frequency: Keep local frequency acquisition locked to existing reference through squelched intervals. Remote frequency offset remains an explicit input bound; normal CDR tracks after phase seeding.
burst_acquisition.hardware: Existing slicer/CDR blocks expanded with8 parallel phase samplers; no8x-frequency sampler clock.32UI circular history stores8samples/UI plus activity/time markers. FPGA modem is not used to choose initial physical sampling phase.
burst_acquisition.history: 32UI x8phase bits=256bits; remaining256bits allocation covers activity flags, row indices, selected-phase replay and small overflow margin. Retain all samples necessary for the first payload even if phase decision finishes after preamble. Mark uncertain prefix invalid; never silently invent bits.
burst_acquisition.phase_selection: Record continuously while armed. On activity, retain4UI pretrigger history, collect8UI, and require at least4 transitions. Histogram transition phases, choose a sample phase at least0.25UI from every accepted transition cluster. Reject ambiguous/multiple-edge/no-margin cases as burst error. No recognition of USB PID/SYNC syntax in chip.
burst_acquisition.qualification: 16UI acquisition and2UI steady pipeline are design targets; early-history reconstruction, jitter/metastability, missing edges, shortened preamble, residual offset and handoff need waveform tests. Existing receive_qualification policy alone does not establish these bounds. For the shortest28UI shortened-SYNC handshake fixture, acquisition/handoff can lag early payload: delayed-ack history tests retain the complete payload and bound drain plus pipeline to8UI. Full packet response pricing uses8UI tail, not only steady-state2UI.
burst_acquisition.replay: Selected-phase historical bits emitted in timestamp order at up to2bits/UI into existing raw-bit/event queue while new samples continue at1bit/UI. Catch up then switch once to live recovered data using acknowledged phase seed and monotonically increasing bit index. No duplicates, omitted accepted bits or event overtaking.
burst_acquisition.turnaround: Receiver and reference stay warm across packet gaps; no per-packet STOP or epoch reset. Local TX release rearms history capture immediately after pad dead time. Complete port-to-port response budget must include replay lag, short-frame commits, both CDCs, FPGA decision, timed output enable and analog settling.

calibration_lifecycle.environment: Require the full measured temperature/supply uncertainty intervals to lie within the characterized envelope, including board-to-die thermal uncertainty and warm-up drift. External sensors/chamber and conservative bounds provide this information; no on-chip temperature sensor is assumed. A narrow operating window is allowed but must be monitored or enforced.
calibration_lifecycle.equipment: Precision DC supply/meter, calibrated RF generator and attenuation, spectrum/vector receiver or characterized SDR, timing oscilloscope/reference counter, suitable FPGA capture, and controlled temperature with supply/temperature logging. Instrument floor, cable loss and reference-plane delay must be included, not subtracted without calibration.
calibration_lifecycle.identity: Key records by externally assigned die identity, assembly/board revision, firmware/coefficient version, reference source, electrical mode, channel, sample rate/divider, filter state, gain, load/PA state and temperature/supply qualification envelope. Replacing die, board or reference plane invalidates the affected records; do not assume a silicon unique-ID fuse exists.
calibration_lifecycle.invalidation: Expired characterization age, unknown time origin, temperature/supply excursion, changed source/board/load/filter/rate/gain or failed health check invalidates dependent records. FPGA reset reloads records and verifies identity/conditions; core power loss also reloads volatile trims and requalifies startup. Source reset requires timing/CFO checks even if DC trims remain usable.
calibration_lifecycle.owner: FPGA plus external characterization equipment; no on-chip nonvolatile tables or new detector pins. Chip stores only active/shadow numeric settings and configuration identity.
calibration_lifecycle.per_board: Host capture/launch timing at intended load, reference input level/delay, RF insertion loss and antenna power, external switch/PA delay and leakage, wired/video path delay/skew. Supply/temperature instrumentation uncertainty belongs in this calibration.
calibration_lifecycle.per_context: RX/TX complex frequency response, IQ/DC correction, gain/power mapping, CFO and antenna-marker delay for each admitted channel/filter/rate/gain/frontend state. Interpolation across contexts is permitted only after held-out validation; no implicit extrapolation.
calibration_lifecycle.per_die: Bias/reference trims, ADC offset/comparator and acquisition/decision settings, DAC offset/gain, RC trim ranges, oscillator/CDR tuning and pad drive/termination. Internal reference-ratio tests check gross function, not absolute accuracy or ENOB.
calibration_lifecycle.retune: Precompute/preload valid next-context settings. The50us hop budget covers selecting/applying an already qualified record and settling, not measuring a new transfer function. Missing target record rejects the scheduled operation. Same-channel turnaround never performs a full calibration.
calibration_lifecycle.scope: Selected lifecycle and acceptance policy, not measured calibration duration, drift or absolute accuracy.
calibration_lifecycle.startup: Load matching persistent FPGA records after identifying hardware and qualifying present conditions. Apply settings while stopped, perform bounded health checks, then arm. If records are absent or invalid, enter explicit instrument-assisted calibration mode; do not pretend cold20us qualification includes a calibration campaign.
calibration_lifecycle.timing: Record measured worst-case apply/settle/check time in each record. Offline duration is sum over points of instrument settle + analog settle + capture_samples/sample_rate, plus transfer, fitting, held-out validation and environmental soak. No fixed calibration completion time is claimed before equipment and sweep size are chosen. Admission reserves measured runtime check cost outside protocol response deadlines.
calibration_lifecycle.validity_model: rf_power_calibration.CalibrationValidity checks identity, characterized age and full uncertainty intervals. PowerCalibration can require this gate before returning amplitude. Legacy context-only tables and other correction paths are not automatically lifecycle-qualified; host integration must gate all affected calibrations.

cdr_tracking_requirements.acquisition: Generic acquisition timeout is24bits (1..16777215 recovered UIs); reset1024UI remains a short default, not universal. Periodic-clock learning prototype requires about105us of observations at2.5Gb/s before computation and actuation; its extended readiness and invalidation are not yet integrated. Delay valid-data declaration until observation and error bounds are qualified. Holdover remains a separate16bit counter; USB retained-frequency burst seeding is distinct from cold serial acquisition.
cdr_tracking_requirements.causal_model_configuration: Selected 96-bin phase-bank detector with optional FPGA-assisted periodic tracking. 1 ppm period commands and 4096-step phase actuator. Periodic acquisition reserves framed host service; 128 observations remain on FPGA. Physical sampler, encoder and actuator budgets are unqualified.
cdr_tracking_requirements.holdover: Residual recovered-clock error is distinct from incoming offset tolerance. Selected controller budgets 125ppm at its last observation; the separate desired tracking target remains50ppm. Add integrated frequency slew, aperture motion and observation uncertainty and require total<0.25UI for each gap.
cdr_tracking_requirements.host_rate: Dense host traffic carries variable source word counts, not unbounded rate-matching FIFO drift. If a line-derived host clock exceeds its allowed physical range, use fixed host_follow clock with sufficient capacity. Do not overclock FPGA GPIO to follow positive line offset.
cdr_tracking_requirements.joint_holdover_acceptance: Admit each numeric configuration only when tracking phase error + timestamp/jitter uncertainty + bounded aperture movement + residual-frequency drift + integrated slew + any unabsorbed commanded phase correction remains below0.25UI over its required gap. Apply elapsed-gap checks before a returning transition resets state. A programmable512UI counter and50ppm residual allocation are not independent guarantees. Timestamp precision and phase movement must be budgeted consistently; correlations require evidence.

local_aperture_supply_coupling.accounting: Budget local supply-induced aperture excursion explicitly alongside residual frequency/slew and other uncertainty. These are distinct from external reference source jitter.
local_aperture_supply_coupling.basis: Selected phase bank requires 0.0025 ps/mV local rejection. Tracking acceptance is scored separately from the 125 ppm holdover allowance.
local_aperture_supply_coupling.implementation: Reduce local clock/detector supply sensitivity or ripple while keeping required bandwidth. Differential cancellation, local filtering and bias regulation require explicit headroom/current/area and stability accounting; no cost-free improvement assumed.
local_aperture_supply_coupling.limits: Conditional acquired-state comparison only. Cold acquisition, actuator latency, statistical tails and full jitter/BER remain open. The separate 50 ppm tracking target is not satisfied by assigning a 125 ppm holdover allocation.
local_aperture_supply_coupling.model_ownership: The normative CDR supply sensitivity and full window-detector controls feed the shared receiver. Older coupling and timestamp-fixture comparisons retain explicit historical or adverse scope.

timestamp_noise_allocation.scope: Within25ps total timestamp envelope. Probability refers to an observation exceeding its timing allowance, not bit error rate or hard bounded Gaussian noise. All systematic/channel/quantization and random timestamp contributors need explicit coverage; physical distribution/tails remain unknown. Earlier5ps RMS candidate runs do not establish this tail allocation.

cdr_tracking_requirements.long_gap_requirement: Retain intended long-gap targets. For the recorded half-coupling2.5Gb/s spectrum with0.0625UI tracking error,25ps reserve and330e6ppm/s slew,192UI allows residual below approximately165ppm, but512UI requires below approximately33ppm before extra correction cost. The50ppm allocation therefore needs reduced aperture movement, tighter phase error or improved frequency tracking for512UI. This is an inverse budget under assigned inputs, not a qualified bound or a reason to reduce target scope.
cdr_tracking_requirements.nominal_vs_actual: 480Mb/s..2.5Gb/s controls are nominal. Oscillator/divider/pad qualification must extend over actual nominal*(1+offset) with selected-configuration trim margin. Do not clamp a positive clock offset at nominal2.5GHz.
cdr_tracking_requirements.physical_margin: Wired VCO qualification0.99..2.525GHz around nominal1..2.5GHz; clocktree/serializer/pad and CDR qualify nominal480Mb/s..2.5Gb/s multiplied by0.99..1.01. Nominal interface targets and pin counts unchanged; these are required tolerance margins, not additional advertised rates.
cdr_tracking_requirements.qualification_limits: After acquisition require deterministic tracking phase error<=0.0625UI, residual frequency error<=50ppm, no correction saturation or cycle slip throughout modulation; retain separate0.0625UI jitter/wander reserve in holdover calculation. Physical random-jitter/BER gate remains separate.
cdr_tracking_requirements.remaining: Time-domain CDR tracking/jitter and loss-recovery qualification still required; timing_services.cdr_holdover_error checks only analytic no-transition drift.
cdr_tracking_requirements.resource: Frequency integration and trim/limit indication within existing CDR loop/control allocation; oscillator and pad margin are physical requirements, not area-free proof.
cdr_tracking_requirements.ssc: Track triangular0..-5000ppm downspread at30..33kHz plus static difference within acquisition bounds. Selected upper frequency slew330e6ppm/s; asymmetric or steeper modulation requires its own bound. TX may use suitably qualified external/common reference; generating SSC is not assumed from static fractional-divider programmability.
cdr_tracking_requirements.tracking: Use existing phase/frequency CDR with frequency-integrating correction, not a phase-only fixed-frequency sampler. Select2.5..7.5MHz loop only after jitter transfer/tolerance and damping qualification. Qualified reception requires bounded phase error, bounded residual frequency error and no saturation/cycle slips; lock flag alone is insufficient.

cdr_traffic_requirements.ac_coupling_alternative: If external circuitry requires AC coupling, its actual high-pass response, data asymmetry, slicer baseline shift and finite run length must be included in the receive eye budget. Simply enlarging the CDR timeout does not restore a shifted voltage baseline. No passing claim for this alternative without that evidence.
cdr_traffic_requirements.causal_model_configuration: RecoveredWordSource now exposes holdover_ui and a finite frequency_correction_limit_ppm (7000 default rather than the obsolete2000ppm clamp). Extended holdover is admitted only with a declared residual-frequency bound and phase budget. The voltage-crossing fixture uses a0.1UI detector-history condition plus0.0625UI uncertainty; this diagnostic rule is not the physical0.0625UI initial-error target or proof that50ppm residual is achieved. The common-envelope bench compares default64UI and configured512UI on a192UI drought. Full SSC acquisition/tracking still requires time-domain evidence.
cdr_traffic_requirements.continuous_stream: Use quiet_source=none when low transition density or baseline wander must never be mistaken for intentional idle. No transition is not zero signal. Clock/supply failure and actual holdover expiry remain faults.
cdr_traffic_requirements.external_sdi_path: Select DC-coupled differential output from external SDI equalizer/reclocker into WIRE_RX, with compatible common mode, internal serial termination and rxlevel bypass. External device must provide cable equalization and any baseline restoration needed at this boundary. An external retimer may additionally clean timing; count its costs explicitly.
cdr_traffic_requirements.holdover_counter_clock: Count acquisition and transition-gap UI limits in the recovered bit-clock domain, not nominal-rate wall time. SSC may lengthen512 received UIs beyond512 nominal UI seconds. Check expiry before accepting a returning transition. Independent reference/supply/clock-presence watchdogs remain active; a stalled recovered counter is not proof of clock health.
cdr_traffic_requirements.holdover_guard: Before arming, require initial_phase_error_ui + longest_run_ui * residual_frequency_error_ppm /1e6 + jitter_and_wander_ui < available_eye_half_width_ui. holdover_bits must be >= longest_run_ui and must also satisfy this phase bound. Raising timeout without satisfying the bound is forbidden.
cdr_traffic_requirements.loop_setting: Loop-gain trim remains2.5..7.5MHz target; qualify tracking, jitter tolerance and transition-density response at selected numeric setting. No universally correct5MHz setting is assumed.
cdr_traffic_requirements.meaning: These are design acceptance allocations, not measured jitter or frequency accuracy. Reference accuracy is not the same as residual recovered-frequency error. Transitions must earn frequency/phase qualification before long holdover is permitted.
cdr_traffic_requirements.model: receive_qualification.holdover_phase_bound evaluates the declared timing budget; ReceiveQualification tests state continuity. Neither substitutes for waveform-level baseline-wander or jitter testing.
cdr_traffic_requirements.modulated_holdover_model: receive_qualification.modulated_holdover_phase_bound integrates supplied piecewise-linear post-tracking frequency error and checks interior phase extrema as well as endpoints. It rejects transient eye violations despite zero final drift. Actual CDR loop response remains a required input, not established by this calculation.
cdr_traffic_requirements.pattern_gate: Exercise sustained unequal mark/space occupancy and sparse transitions, not merely alternating data or PRBS. For HD-SDI include equalizer-stressing and PLL-stressing pathological streams, then ordinary data recovery, under the same pad/clock/load assumptions. No protocol-specific detector on chip.
cdr_traffic_requirements.selection: Host supplies numeric worst-case transition-gap and residual-frequency-error bounds, not a protocol selector. The64UI reset default is not a universal operating configuration.
cdr_traffic_requirements.time_varying_frequency_guard: For modulated incoming clocks, integrate residual frequency error through each transition gap, including loop lag, then add initial phase error and untracked jitter. Constant-ppm holdover alone does not qualify SSC tracking. Keep analog state through idle/OOB handoff; bound reacquisition separately.

control_calibration.cdr: Loop gain code maps0.5..1.5 times5MHz nominal bandwidth; holdover counts bit intervals after acquisition.
control_calibration.converter: DAC gain trim maps0.8..1.2; offset maps-0.02..0.02V. ADC comparator trim maps-0.05..0.05V. Local asynchronous timing codes are target intervals requiring later circuit calibration.
control_calibration.ctle: Each8-bit trim maps0.5..1.5 times nominal time constant.
control_calibration.detect: Threshold code maps0..3.3V; current code maps50..150uA.
control_calibration.hostio: Drive codes0..3 request PDRV00..03; slew0=SL0,1=SL1. Reset drive1 remains conditional on GPIO timing/current qualification.
control_calibration.monitor: Supply threshold code maps0..5.10V in20mV steps; default2.50/3.60V is a model-validity safety window, not full-performance guarantee. Supply mask bits0..5=RF,WIRE,PLL,CONV,CORE,HOST. Core undervoltage always resets outputs regardless of mask. Qualification/loss intervals use independent management oscillator.
control_calibration.pll: 6-bit charge-pump code maps25..75uA; coarse VCO code selects monotonic frequency subrange within declared VCO coverage, with overlap required; feedback N+F/2^24 and reference divider R set output=fref*(N+F/2^24)/R.
control_calibration.quadrature: Each8-bit trim maps0.75..1.25 times nominal RC.
control_calibration.rfdriver: gain code maps 1..6.4; code206 gives5.36235, the representable the current design setting nearest nominal5.36.
control_calibration.rxfilter: cutoff linearly maps 0.1..9.53125 MHz; Q codes map 0.5..12; zero codes map 1.01..20 times cutoff; finite_zeros=0 bypasses numerator zeros. Set coefficients before enabling; default codes are safe disabled reset settings, not the elliptic recipe.
control_calibration.termination: Trim maps0.8..1.2 times selected nominal resistance.
control_calibration.txfilter: cutoff maps0.1..12MHz; q_code is a calibrated common damping trim around Q0.618/1.618 stages, nominal at128. Gain code maps0..2. Fixed-response model qualifies unity gain and Butterworth values only; other shapes need explicit modeling.
control_calibration.usb: HS current trim maps0.8..1.2 times17.78mA; use the actual8-bit current_code. Calibrate at actual board rail/load. Provisional absolute low-frequency fractional current sensitivity target is <=0.2/V; the common rail plus +/-5percent termination screen rejects a +0.5/V source even at maximum trim. This target is a modeled requirement, not measured PSRR; qualify dynamic reference response and switching extrema separately; squelch/disconnect trims map0.8..1.2 times respective nominal thresholds. FS output resistance trim maps0.8..1.2 times43ohm before2ohm switch.
control_calibration.wiredtx: 8-bit current maps2..16mA; postcursor maps0..0.5 of main current.

periodic_tracking_enable.description: Enable periodic clock prediction while stopped; reserve framed observation/coefficient service during acquisition; invalidate on mismatch or epoch reset.

clocktree.config.update: stopped; sync_arm one-shot while all payload outputs muted, source already locked and prefill valid

digital.hop_config.update: load next context while active; commit only on validated exclusiveRF arm metadata with converters muted and no prior hop pending

digital.transport_config.update: stopped_only; requires trained100MHz SDR host_follow, warmed480MHz line clock, both FIFO epochs reset and initial credits acknowledged

control_semantics.alignment_marker: When sync_arm=1, CS_N high and payload stopped/muted, treat rising SPI_SCLK as one-shot epoch marker. FPGA broadcasts identical marker to all dies only after each reports armed. Do not issue normal SPI accesses during armed interval. Never repurpose RESET_N as a post-lock alignment event. Shared SCLK fanout adds no chip pin; use individually selected CS_N/status reads outside armed interval.
control_semantics.burst_enable_guard: Burst sampler enabled only at480..640Mb/s, qualified local reference/frequency and host direct_stream mode for selected USB; explicit raw-record fixtures remain scoped evidence. Continuous recording begins before receiving a burst. Other rates use tracking samplers; burst bank off. Local TX gates receive acceptance. USB selects squelch quiet policy and report_drop acquisition failures.
control_semantics.commit: Validate shadow configuration and ownership before atomic commit. Stopped-only means payload stopped, outputs isolated and pending actions cancelled. Configuration register address allocation belongs to digital implementation; these are the complete analog boundary fields.
control_semantics.converter_guard: Acquisition + decision + reset must fit the programmed sample period; paired I/Q commit atomically.
control_semantics.encoding: Enums use zero-based list index. Unsigned fields use binary encoding. Out-of-range writes rejected atomically. Reserved encodings rejected.
control_semantics.external_protocols: USB host/device negotiation and all protocol recipes remain FPGA responsibilities. Pull and termination controls are independent of capture/playback.
control_semantics.fault_recovery: Unexpected faults require explicit host acknowledgment and new epoch. Normal selected electrical idle/USB squelch only closes RX validity and preserves stream epoch/other direction. Acquisition drop policy reports a bad burst without global reset; supply/reference loss always faults.

guard_domains.clock_loss: H2D scheduler loss or reference loss cancels pending live actions and enters independent management fault path.
guard_domains.qualification: Numeric guard defaults are design allocations, not demonstrated analog settling. Increase guard for measured filter history/board-switch delays; reject any requested air-launch deadline earlier than readiness. Do not silently delay an expired response.
guard_domains.ready_rule: Warm direction change requires already-valid bias/reference/source, correct epoch, prefilled TX data or RX acceptance preparation. Failed readiness stays muted/invalid. A startup-ready flag does not assert direction-settled.
guard_domains.rf_direction: digital.guard_config rx_to_tx_ticks/tx_to_rx_ticks on H2D_CLK/4; defaults32ticks=819.2ns atH0. Independent of startup guard. Start guard at actual mute/gate action; retain source/ADC/DAC/host clock phase, references and stream epoch.
guard_domains.rf_gain: gain_settle_ticks defaults8ticks=204.8ns atH0; atomic I/Q gain commit, invalidate samples until guard expires without flushing transport.
guard_domains.startup: monitor.config.qualification_ticks on independent management oscillator; default1200ticks ensures>=20us at60MHz; used only after cold start, bias/reference invalidation or source change.
guard_domains.wire_trim: wire_trim_settle_ui defaults16lineUIs; controls take effect at complete serializer-word boundary; settled status rounded up to next word boundary. No clock reset or training-pattern gap.

control_semantics.host_clock_guard: Framed line_divided mode obeys60..156.25MHz physical DDR and sustained-service bounds. USB direct_stream requires100MHz SDR host_follow in both directions. RF default carrier/32 is separately configured. No DDR or short-frame requirement applies to direct_stream.
control_semantics.host_follow_guard: host_follow uses conditioned H2D, not line_clock/divider. Keep H2D running throughout armed traffic. Direct stream captures one edge at100MHz; framed service uses its selected DDR timing. Both require calibrated capture including buffers/routing. Clock loss cancels pending actions through independent management.
control_semantics.illegal: Reject conflicting ownership, simultaneous push-pull/current drivers, simultaneous serial/TMDS branches, active RF and wired payload, test-current injection during active drive, or invalid converter timing. Retain prior configuration and latch CONFIG_ERROR.

pga_i.gain.boundary: Paired I/Q sample boundary, atomic commit; samples during selected gain guard invalid.

pga_q.gain.boundary: Paired I/Q sample boundary, atomic commit; samples during selected gain guard invalid.

wiredtx.config.acknowledgment: Report applied word index and settled word index; FPGA continues training pattern until settled. Invalid/late/stale requests leave old fields active.
wiredtx.config.boundary: Apply both shadow fields atomically at next complete serializer-word boundary after scheduled timestamp; never restart PLL, serializer, FIFO or epoch.
wiredtx.config.fault: Fault/underrun still overrides output; training permission cannot bypass pad ownership or current limits.
wiredtx.config.implementation: Thermometer/current-cell control commits from local registered shadow; monotonic bounded current transition, no intentional electrical-idle insertion. Hold training permission until settled acknowledgment.
wiredtx.config.permission: Host explicitly opens generic analog-training window; not inferred from a protocol or decoded pattern.

control_semantics.monitor_guard: SPI may set a stronger monitoring mask, never weaker than active mode requirements: always PLL/CORE/HOST, plusRF/CONV forRF, WIRE forwired/USB. Require reference inRF; require input presence when external timing or PLL reference is used; require selectedPLL lock. CDR loss is armed only after qualified acquisition. Hardware mode validation rejects insufficient mask/requirements. CDR loss input now means qualified unexpected loss after receive_qualification policy, not raw transition absence; ordinary quiet never reaches global fault latch. During explicitly armed RETUNE_WINDOW only, source presence/selectedRFPLL-lock may be absent while converters isolated; supply and host requirements remain mandatory. Restore all source requirements on window exit.
control_semantics.receiver_detection: While wired payload stopped, select txpad detect with wiredtx.idle=tmds.idle=1, their output states off, and source termination off. Reset counter, capture initial TX-pad voltage, then scheduled-enable paired test currents. Threshold crossings are timestamped on DETECT_CLOCK. Both sources disconnect at crossing/timeout/fault. Clear test enable before changing pad branch. Timeout uses selected detector clock:250000ticks gives0.5..1ms. No current injected into WIRE_RX or USB. Reject test enable in any other ownership state.
control_semantics.reference_clock_guard: In high-frequency mode select divider so low_ref is10..250MHz for CDR/PLL acquisition; high_ref remains undivided. No simultaneous independent clock inputs. Both PLL feedback loops must remain within VCO/PFD ranges.
control_semantics.reset: All fields take declared defaults. Physical output enables are additionally forced off by reset/fault regardless of shadow settings. Bias, monitor, management oscillator and SPI remain enabled after power-on startup.
control_semantics.rf_frequency_guard: Polyphase requires carrier=input2.4..2.5GHz. Divide-by-two requires input480..2500MHz and carrier=input/2. Sample and RF host clocks divide actual carrier, not raw REF_IN. No native1250..2400MHz claim. Below240MHz or other bands use external frequency conversion.
control_semantics.rx_level_guard: Require half for DC high-common-mode TMDS sink plus external pullups and internal shunts off; bypass for serial CTLE. USB selects its dedicated preamplifier and leaves this path off.
control_semantics.scheduled: Only explicitly live fields may change at a timestamp. Fault overrides every scheduled action. Analog settling guard expires before data becomes valid; clocks remain running during same-channel RF direction change.
control_semantics.scheduler_clock: Active scheduled actions use H2D_CLK/4 as in clock-rate-ownership.md (25.6ns ticks in H0). Management oscillator only supervises recovery; detector clock independently captures4ns intervals. Do not reinterpret one domain ticks as another.
control_semantics.state_ownership: Per-block state requests are checked against operating_modes.block_states; warm/active may be reduced to off. source_dependent and branch_dependent require their stated selector. Safety output constraints always dominate requested enable.
control_semantics.trim_mapping: Unless overridden, centered trim uses code/(2**bits-1), maps declared min/max linearly and saturates at endpoints. Code 128/32 denotes near midpoint, not exact physical calibration.

direct_stream_service.clocks: GPIO capture/control100MHz. RX record CDC has two synchronizer stages plus consumer edge at100MHz. TX tiny FIFO consumer/gearbox uses local TX_CLOCK divided by2=240MHz at480Mb/s; this is a local digital divider, not a new PLL/pin. Bit serialization480MHz. Physical metastability and clock-to-pin timing still require implementation qualification.
direct_stream_service.credits: Eight initial FIFO slots after shared epoch reset. Each non-IDLE TX word consumes one slot; each consumed FIFO word increments modulo32 return count sent on D2H. FPGA accepts only increments <=outstanding count; duplicate counts give no new credits. Return bound four100MHz cycles after consumption includes synchronizer/serialization/capture. Credit loss stalls safely; no guessed credits. During local TX RX payload is gated, so credit return does not compete with incoming USB data. Arbitrary simultaneous RX/TX requires a separate service bound.
direct_stream_service.evidence: verification/usb_selected_timing.py: actual streamed DATA request, external USBStreamingPacket CRC/PID/framing, causal120ns decision, encoded ACK, finite BlockFIFO CDC, credits and playback;240phase pairs, long1024byte RX/TX, bounded stalls and invalid-packet suppression. direct_stream.py codec tests partial lengths, parity, malformed order and credit wrap.
direct_stream_service.guards: Minimum8lineUI reply gap. No warm RF or startup guard on a warm USB reply. Host/reference loss, reset, stale epoch, malformed controls, FIFO overflow or active underrun cancels/mutes and invalidates stream; software recovery cannot meet the current packet deadline. No silent repeat or delayed replay.
direct_stream_service.host_obligations: 100MHz streaming hardware, at most8raw bits consumed/produced per cycle,12cycles after final capture for validation/action selection. Buffered DATA and CRC/bit stuffing live in FPGA. No claim MCU firmware can service USB HS.800Mb/s raw byte capacity before controls; tested one idle cycle per eight host cycles during TX. Initial credits/readiness must already be valid.
direct_stream_service.qualification: Component system model with assigned analog reception/settling and ideal trained GPIO. FPGA synthesis/timing closure, actual pad/clock/package, full protocol controllers and canonical BehavioralChip/RTL integration remain open.342.25ns is a conditional design allocation, not measured USB compliance.
direct_stream_service.resources: Reuse ingress/egress and staging. Each eight-entry10-bit FIFO80bits, two CDC pointers and synchronizers within existing counters;128bit playback staging within512bit allocation. Decoder/credit state reserved128bits below. Reserve existing50000um2/5mA digital fast-service allocation for decoder, credit and local240MHz control; not extra area/current. No pin, ADC, PLL or packet RAM added.
direct_stream_service.rx: Publish validated raw bytes as samples arrive; partial-count/data/END ordered after assigned8UI receive tail and4UI quiet qualification. FPGA parser updates NRZI/unstuffing/CRC while data arrives. FPGA decides only after END and CRC result; no optimistic early ACK. RX cannot be backpressured; FPGA must accept each100MHz beat. No competing management payload on this transport; SPI remains separate.
direct_stream_service.sampled_receive_boundary: Generic sampled signal/quiet observations form raw burst records, without packet length or protocol syntax. Two consecutive quiet samples qualify END. Signal returning after a single quiet sample emits ABORT because a bit may have been erased; never silently splice later bits into the burst. This is a behavioral control requirement using existing START/END/ABORT transport. Physical squelch filtering, sampling phase acquisition and implementation timing/state accounting remain unqualified.
direct_stream_service.selection: Generic raw-bit burst service on existing H2D/D2H 10-bit buses;100MHz SDR, common H2D-derived D2H clock. Stopped-only alternative transport encoding within the single chip design; framed transport retained for other configurations. No protocol profiles or on-chip USB CRC/PID/endpoint parser.
direct_stream_service.tx: START then raw bytes; wait32prefilled bits (four bytes) before first line bit, or full END for shorter generic burst. Finish only on END. Eight-entry FIFO with cumulative credits; never assume unlimited response storage. FPGA supplies encoded reply, may prepare it earlier but no preloaded chip templates required. Data longer than FIFO streams while transmitting.

wire_format.control: bit8=0; payload0 IDLE,1 START,2 END,3 ABORT,0x11..0x17 next data contains1..7 valid low bits and must be followed by END,0x40..0x5f cumulative credit count modulo32. Other codes invalid. IDLE/credits may interleave. No full-frame wait.
wire_format.data: bit8=1, bits7:0 eight chronological raw line levels LSB first; bit9 even parity over bits8:0
wire_format.errors: Reject parity, padding and ordering errors; cancel output, flush pending data and require coordinated epoch reset. Parity detects single-bit corruption only; no link ECC or guaranteed multi-bit protection.

host_transport_selection.admission: Require per-direction useful service after headers, credits and control traffic, plus finite-queue reserve for bounded host stalls and clock mismatch. Dense59/64 capacity requires exclusive payload-slot allocation. Never repeat/drop line bits or samples to conceal drift. Admit actual FPGA/board loading and timing, not arbitrary GPIOs.
host_transport_selection.decision: Retain direct byte streaming and dense framed transport as two encodings of the same physical host buses. Byte streaming is not the only interface mode; SPI remains independent configuration/recovery.
host_transport_selection.dense_stream: Ten payload bits per data beat,59payload beats per64word frame, exclusive wired or RF ownership; up to312.5Mword/s. Used for sustained high-rate wired lanes and high-rate I/Q.
host_transport_selection.direct_stream: 100MHz SDR byte/control/parity for response-critical bursts; currently qualified mathematically for the selected480Mb/s USB component path. No automatic extension of that lifecycle/credit model to simultaneous full-duplex or RF.
host_transport_selection.integration: Reuse pins, capture/launch cells, bounded queues, clock supervision and reset/epoch machinery. Encoding changes require stopped payload, muted outputs, flush and coordinated retraining; no automatic switching during traffic. Formats are configurations of one normative design, not separate design revisions.
host_transport_selection.model_admission: IntegratedTransceiverChip.configure_resources accepts explicit per-direction host_service envelopes and rejects insufficient board rate, sustained service or queue reserve before changing resources. resource_configuration.validate_host_service owns the conditional rate-latency calculation. Missing envelopes remain unqualified legacy fixtures; acceptance does not prove the supplied board guarantee, actual queue placement, direct-stream runtime integration or GPIO timing.
host_transport_selection.physical_load_owner: contract.json:physical_services.host_output;6pF external output load target, with separately accounted pad/package load. Direct USB latency and sustained dense capacity are separate obligations.
host_transport_selection.reason: At maximum selected312.5Mword/s, byte-only transport has zero nominal headroom for2.5Gb/s before controls, credits or clock tolerance. At100MHz it cannot carry960Mb/s maximum12-bit I/Q transport. Removing parity/control to recover bandwidth, widening pins or raising GPIO speed is an architectural change, not a free simplification.
host_transport_selection.scope: Capacity arithmetic selects architecture; it does not establish physical host timing, complete model integration or FPGA implementation closure.

board_passives: Band-specific RF preselection, matching/balun, TX harmonic filtering and permitted AC coupling at existing RF terminals.
Interface-specific wired coupling and TMDS sink pullups; USB switched HS termination and FS source impedance remain local.
Bulk supply decoupling and board feed filtering at existing supply sites; retain local high-frequency decoupling and reference reservoir.
implementation_ownership.decision: FPGA owns adaptive computation and bulk state; board owns interface passives and bulk supply storage; silicon owns fast feedback, conversion and bounded timed execution. No additional analog escape pins selected.
implementation_ownership.evidence_limits: Allocation decision, not physical validation. No area/current saving credited for already-external functions or unimplemented calibration logic. Correction cannot recover clipping, aliasing or stochastic clock noise. External active clock/LO and PA options remain separate from passive offloading.
fpga: Calibration search/optimization and persistent trim tables, including PLL coarse-bank selection, filter RC, quadrature, offset, gain and termination calibration; local chip observations and numeric trims are actuators, not an autonomous search engine.
I/Q imbalance correction, residual digital DC removal, converter transfer correction where identifiable, channel FIR/decimation, TX interpolation and pre-emphasis within converter range.
AGC decisions, hop schedules, recovery policy, protocols/modems, CRC/FEC and bulk buffering. Existing causal gain/hop/USB deadlines still apply.

rejected_external_nodes.iq_filters: A board insertion between differential I/Q stages requires at least8 signal sites per RX or TX chain (two differential inputs and two differential outputs); both directions consume16 of19 spares before return/guard needs, and require off-chip-capable drivers. This excludes exposing individual biquad nodes.
rejected_external_nodes.pll_filter: One exposed charge-pump/VCO control node per PLL would need two additional signal sites overall plus quiet return routing. With a hypothetical2.7pF pad, a10pF filter capacitor changes27% before PCB capacitance; phase-noise pickup is not bounded by this capacitance arithmetic.
rejected_external_nodes.reference: Low bandwidth alone does not justify an external high-impedance reference: input leakage, startup and converter kickback need qualification. Local buffering remains mandatory.

retain_local: RF and wired PLL charge-pump loop filters and CDR feedback; no exposed VCO tuning nodes.
Bias startup, current mirrors, reference buffer and 100pF converter reservoir; no new high-impedance bias/reference pins.
RX anti-alias/blocker filtering and TX reconstruction filtering, mixer TIAs and PGAs. FPGA channel filtering cannot prevent pre-ADC overload or aliasing.
ADC acquisition/comparator/SAR timing, DAC switches, quadrature and clock distribution, serializers, burst acquisition and timed USB pad switching.
Atomic trim commit, bounded current/next context, fault isolation and finite CDC queues.

mode_transitions.fault: Asynchronous output-disable dominates scheduled controls. Sticky cause crosses to management clock; payload becomes invalid. Recovery requires explicit host acknowledgment and new epoch.
mode_transitions.other_payload_changes: STOP first; drain or explicitly discard queued words; isolate outputs, cancel pending actions; apply stopped configuration and increment epoch. External peer need not be silent; local output ownership must be safe.
mode_transitions.reset_to_stopped: Mute/isolate outputs immediately. Start bias and independent management oscillator; SPI remains accessible. Wait bias/ref/supply ready before arming payload.
mode_transitions.rf_rx_to_rf_tx: Retain LO/sample/host clocks and epoch. Stop RX acceptance at scheduled sample boundary, retain RX bias, hold DAC zero until valid prefill; begin direction guard at gate change; schedule DAC playback/filter priming so output valid by requested unmute. Unmute only after rx_to_tx_ticks plus independently budgeted board/filter readiness; late/underfilled/faulted requests stay muted.
mode_transitions.rf_tx_to_rf_rx: Mute at scheduled boundary, retain TX bias and clocks, then enable valid RX samples after tx_to_rx_ticks and actual filter/switch readiness. No STOP or epoch increment.
mode_transitions.settling_guard: Cold start uses monitor management-clock qualification_ticks; same-channel direction/gain actions exclusively use digital.guard_config H2D-derived ticks. Never substitute the cold-start20us guard for a live direction change. All require actual source/reference readiness and fault override.
mode_transitions.stopped_to_payload: Validate all controls, mode ownership and supply. Enable selected reference source and local clocks; wait source lock/presence, reference guard and configured filter settling; train host/capture, set new epoch, then arm.

host_switching.scope: Effective per-transition internal H2D input and D2H output charge for the shared supply model. Eleven alternating inputs are the assigned activity fixture. This is not pad capacitance, measured GF180 energy or an SDR waveform qualification.

paired_adc.scope: Assigned independent sampling aperture jitter beyond delivered-clock timing; not measured GF180 performance. ENOB target remains ADC-block-owned.

paired_dac.scope: Assigned excess-noise and aperture hypotheses for the behavioral DAC pair, not measured GF180 performance. Native precision, transport, full-scale and rate are block-owned.

paired_sar.scope: Shared paired-converter device-law hypotheses, not characterized GF180 performance. Timing/allocation, reference and diagnostic loading come from their owning blocks; these remaining low-level assumptions are shared by both ADC lanes.

paired_sar_comparator.scope: Assigned regenerative comparator law used by the retained-state lifecycle adapter; no measured GF180 calibration. Fixed-decision-time converter controls may omit this law explicitly.

reference_input_acceptance.scope: Incremental receiver threshold and effective/individual-leg input envelopes; not protection or absolute-voltage ratings.

reference_input_package.scope: Reference signal bonds and external source series resistance; distinct from the power-delivery network. Pad capacitance remains owned by refpad.

rf_output.status: Unmeasured behavioral distortion allocation; not calibrated silicon performance

rf_receive_supply.scope: Required broadband frontend gain regulation: gain multiplier = 1 + 0.02*(local rail/gain reference - 1). Applied to combined early receive gain, including blocker and noise, over modeled supply disturbances. PGA headroom still follows actual rail. Circuit implementation, bandwidth and power remain unverified; this is a behavioral requirement, not measured GF180 performance.

wired_pad_driver.scope: Local shared-pad current law and linear leakage. Zero output conductance and zero supply sensitivity are ideal controls, not demonstrated transistor performance. Peer behavior remains an independent fixture.

wired_pad_sensing.scope: Single-ended raw sensing thresholds; instantaneous comparisons without hysteresis or noise. Not USB receiver compliance limits. Differential squelch is owned by blocks.usbhs.parameters.squelch_v.

wired_supply_gain.scope: Linear wired driver/receiver gain proportional to local rail divided by this characterization voltage. Independent of actual board source voltage; not a measured device gain law.

forwarded_clock_pi.scope: Reference-sampled PI/VCO reduction for retained forwarded-clock lifecycle. VCO gain/range, output divider, settle guard and phase qualification come from block inventory. PI bandwidth/damping are behavioral requirements, not a derivation of charge-pump circuit performance.

forwarded_stream_service.scope: Retained framed-video service using shared ingress capacity; assigned pointer/consumer CDC latency, explicit launch prefill and eight-UI serializer pipeline. FPGA supplies encoded symbols; no added protocol engine or storage.

Eight time-ordered binary samples per local UI, with row timestamp from retained CDR clock; always recorded when burst mode armed, including quiet.

acceptance.active: Use total active plus inactive loading. Check delivered bandwidth/eye or RF quality, common mode, per-terminal voltage, power and return current in the complete path.
acceptance.disabled_reset_unpowered: Keep external sources connected. Check both supply orders, leakage/backfeed and internal stress; never infer power-off safety from a logical enable or a low internal voltage.
acceptance.package: Retain provider-compatible bond geometry and fixed power/ground sites. Bond, return and board parasitics belong to the external network and must be counted once.
acceptance.promotion: A behavioral target is a requirement for later transistor/PEX work, not a demonstrated achievable pad.
acceptance.protection: Clamp threshold alone is insufficient: include dynamic resistance and package overshoot. No ESD or device-safety verdict without qualified device limits.
acceptance.reconfiguration: Retain network state through break/make, finite command latency, injected charge and clamp return. Do not reset capacitor voltages or clip away excursions.

host_control.behavior: Programmable digital drive/slew and input loading; timing, energy and supply/return current must use the same setting. External load excludes on-die capacitance.

reference_clock.behavior: Differential AC-coupled input. Evaluate each leg, common-mode conversion, threshold crossings, loading, additive noise and supply-induced timing together.

rf_receive.behavior: Differential AC-coupled low-capacitance input; common mode and external source impedance explicit. No digital driver or USB/wired protection path.

rf_transmit.behavior: Differential analog output with explicit series loss, per-leg capacitance, bond/matching load and current/compliance checks. Bias/output-stage dynamics remain owned by rfdriver.
rf_transmit.capacitance_convention: Symmetric per-leg shunt C corresponds to C/2 across the differential pair; include no second copy in the board load.

supply_return.behavior: Retain provider supply/ground sites. Model shared return impedance and injected host, clock, converter and clamp currents; a ground pad is not ideal ground. Package parasitics are counted in the external network.
supply_return.model: verification/baseline_envelope.py inventory_environment and retained package models

wired_receive_usb.behavior: Exclusive receive/termination/USB/TMDS-divider branches on one physical pair. Disabled branches retain capacitance, leakage and internal stress. Reset and unpowered states must release drivers without software.

wired_transmit.behavior: Exclusive serializer driver, DC-coupled TMDS current sink and load-detection branches; normal externally driven voltage must not back-power a collapsed supply.
wired_transmit.model: SharedWiredPad passive/protection studies plus separate serial/TMDS/detection driver models; complete TX branch join pending

pad_behavioral_contract.parameter_policy: Every value is an assigned model parameter, design requirement or measured bound. Current entries are assigned or requirements only. null means unknown/unqualified, never zero or ideal behavior. shared_wired_network.protection_model_policy: No default clamp silently qualifies protection. Explicit rail/ground clamp laws in shared-pad sweeps are hypotheses; None means omitted/unqualified. Selected topology remains ground-primary with power-off-tolerant isolation.

receive_qualification.acquisition: Quiet exit starts a new acquisition interval. Initial lack of phase lock is not loss of a previously valid stream. receive_qualification.model_scope: receive_qualification.py models state policy using supplied phase/level observations. It does not establish analog detection latency, PLL lock or burst acquisition performance.
receive_qualification.ownership: No PCIe/SATA/USB packet parser in chip; FPGA selects generic quiet policy and receives RX_STATE, quiet observations and existing events. Protocol timeouts remain FPGA responsibilities.
receive_qualification.priority: Reference/supply loss and reset override quiet permissions. Local TX enables gate RX acceptance so own transmission is not a new receive burst. Host quiet requests are bounded and cannot indefinitely mask a failed active receiver.
receive_qualification.quiet: Select independent envelope quiet, HS squelch, or bounded scheduled quiet. Keep reference/frequency state and stream epoch; invalidate RX payload while quiet. No automatic STOP/flush/global fault for ordinary silence. Quiet is not inferred from missing bit transitions.
receive_qualification.tracking: Transition-qualified samples reset the no-transition age. No-transition intervals enter holdover with retained phase/frequency and bounded validity. Renewed phase-qualified transitions restore tracking without epoch change.
receive_qualification.unexpected_loss: Only timeout of allowed holdover or failed tracking while signal is expected produces cdr.loss to supervisor. Detect/squelch selection and qualification must precede the transition-gap timeout; a declared packet/idle boundary closes that RX segment, not the entire stream.

rf_gain_feedback.admission: Fast gain action requires bounded frame service in both directions, no competing management commands, and queued/discarded samples plus ceil(settle*sample_rate)<=127. Reserve at most24stale pairs for fast path. Otherwise reject before committing or perform explicit full capture discontinuity outside packet; never truncate loss count or silently assert clean data. Third-frame budgets include pending status priority.
rf_gain_feedback.command: Exclusive RF framed H2D metadata opcode4; argument bits6:5 LNA index[-6,0,10,20]dB,bits4:0 shared I/Q PGA index[-6..42]dB in3dB steps,bit7=0. wc=qc=0. Existing protected header, guard and sequence validated before atomic gain commit. RF_RX acquisition permission and completed sample snapshot required; reject fast commands during snapshot assembly without committing. Only one pending gain action until status. Offset calibration is preloaded separately, not unbounded hidden in this command.
rf_gain_feedback.ownership: FPGA estimates signal/overload from streamed I/Q and ADC overload status. Chip provides atomic scheduled LNA/PGA/offset update plus clean-sample boundary; no on-chip packet detector/modem/AGC policy.
rf_gain_feedback.packet_admission: FPGA schedules gain changes only in acquisition interval and freezes gain for payload. A second3us round fits only if actual preamble/training time remaining covers6us plus detection/synchronization reserve. If not, preload calibrated gain, use one bounded correction or reject that operating envelope; do not consume payload as synthetic training.
rf_gain_feedback.packet_examples: At37.5MS/s selected round trip2.984933us: two updates within8us leave2.030133us for synchronization; one within4us leaves1.015067us. Examples apply only where the real waveform provides these training windows. Narrow sample/filter settings recompute actual budget rather than inheriting these figures.
rf_gain_feedback.packing: At explicit gain/discontinuity frame boundary, partial old I/Q pair is discarded and counted; pack new complete24bit pairs from bit0 and pad final10bit word with zero. At that boundary floor(qc*10/24) determines complete pairs; incomplete padding never becomes a sample. Ordinary uninterrupted frames retain existing carry semantics.
rf_gain_feedback.remaining: Full analog recovery/acquisition and RTL integration remain unqualified. rf_gain_command.py defines protected command/status and FPGA pair/gap decoding. BehavioralChip emits gain status from actual finite RX queue discard after an explicitly delivered command and supplied settling count. The Wi-Fi gain-feedback screen joins downstream PGA/ADC behavior to sample-driven FPGA decisions and serialized snapshots/status. Its FPGA-only diagnostic policy uses short-training correlation to gate one peak-based gain correction and freezes gain afterward. The nominal200ns shared PGA response now admits the correction using127-pair status. FPGA acquisition uses a32-sample coarse correlation and16-sample plateau, followed by unchanged paired64-sample LTF checks; invalid samples remain excluded through resampling. Selected strong/weak diagnostic MCS7 cases decode without a faster PGA assumption. These are diagnostic DATA and legacy-training results, not complete HE packets. Initial-gain sensitivity/overload tradeoffs, realistic packet/blocker statistics and gain changes with peer-clock resampling remain unqualified. Actual H2D parsing/CDC and physical timing remain qualification obligations; a bounded arrival assumption is charged in the model. timing_services.py prices the complete selected path. FPGA supplies waveform-specific preamble deadline and rejects an action that cannot settle before payload.
rf_gain_feedback.selected_wideband_budget: Include150ns frontend/sample-pipeline bound, then16samples at>=37.5MS/s, stable156.25Mword/s D2H,312.5Mword/s H2D, three64word frame periods each direction for wait/stage/emit,100ns FPGA decision, six156.25MHz cycles forCDC/commit,400ns settling and one sample for first-clean output. Total<3us. Guard204.8ns reset default is not this complete bound.
rf_gain_feedback.settling: 400ns is a wideband acceptance target only. Prefer calibrated/preloaded LNA gain and downstream PGA-only acquisition corrections. An upstream LNA change perturbs retained channel-filter history and requires its own settling bound; do not apply the PGA guard to it. If upstream clipping is suspected, a PGA reduction cannot repair it: change LNA gain only with admitted recovery time, otherwise reject that packet/envelope. Actual LNA/filter/PGA overload recovery, offset and board history determine settling. Narrow filters require larger supplied bound; cannot use wideband delay for LoRa. Calibration must retain realistic capacitor/filter state.
rf_gain_feedback.status: D2H opcode4 echoes applied gain in argument; wc holds low six bits and STATUS-only argument bit7 holds bit6 of invalid/discarded complex sample pairs0..127, qc counts new-gain payload words<=59. No wire data in exclusive RF. Finish already-staged old-gain frames first, discard stale queued samples at commit and invalidate settling samples. Start fresh I/Q packing at this status boundary; FPGA resets old partial-pair packing and advances sample index by reported loss before consuming new-gain pairs. Count loss from the first pair not completely delivered, including any discarded partial pair exactly once; zero loss with a partial pair is invalid. Padding at each discontinuity boundary is explicit. No new-gain data released under old metadata.

calibration.correction: FPGA digital complex correction plus existing PGA/trim actuators. RX analog DC cancellation protects headroom. Digital TX DC injection cancels LO feedthrough only within calibrated linear range; do not assume infinite correction authority.
calibration.fault_validity: FPGA-owned calibration records bind an analog-condition generation as well as die/board/configuration and measured supply/temperature/age bounds. Advance generation on observed reference/clock loss, brownout, reset or an unqualified condition excursion affecting the calibrated path. Restoring nominal conditions or clearing the stream fault does not revalidate old records. Requalification/remeasurement must explicitly establish the new generation. Routine stream epochs and stopped diagnostic selections are not automatically analog health changes. Maintain separate path generations where independence is justified; no extra chip calibration memory or protocol-specific command.
calibration.owner: FPGA and external equipment; no new on-chip detector or loopback pins.
calibration.rx: Inject known swept tones and packet levels through RF_RX with calibrated source/attenuator. Fit gain, frequency-dependent IQ response, DC offset, overload/recovery and antenna-to-sample delay for each used frequency/gain/filter/temperature/supply context.
calibration.storage: Full tables and fit coefficients on FPGA; chip holds active/next numeric settings only. Reject absent/stale/out-of-range calibration and preserve host sample epoch. Power tables include waveform bandwidth, normalization and qualified crest allowance in their context. Invert only within characterized monotonic range; include measurement/interpolation uncertainty against the power ceiling. FPGA preflights native sample peaks after resampling, NCO, IQ and DC correction before committing queue data. Digital peak checks do not prove analog reconstruction or PA headroom.
calibration.triggered_uplink: Calibrated RSSI from sample power and gain state; repeated-training cross-power with an external known-level reference is exercised at three input levels in the behavioral bench, not qualified under arbitrary blockers/fading; derive frequency correction from actual received preamble and apply digital TX NCO/resampling. Account residual CFO statistics, requested transmit power and unused-tone leakage. FPGA pilot-based frequency prediction is optional and must remain disabled by default until an admission rule is validated against acquisition-only operation. CRC validity alone is insufficient: require adequate observation duration, pilot signal quality, bounded phase ambiguity and demonstrated prediction uncertainty at scheduled TX time. Account pilot polarity/RU geometry and finish any admitted update within the existing FPGA decision allocation. On rejection, retain the acquisition estimate; do not use expected payload or injected carrier truth for admission. The last-eight-symbol diagnostic improves long synthetic records but worsens the maximum estimate error on independent short legacy packets. Short HE triggers, interference/fading confidence, independent sample drift and standards CFO statistics remain unqualified. No new chip control or memory is required.
calibration.tx: Capture RF_TX through calibrated attenuation into vector receiver and power meter. Fit IQ/image and carrier leakage correction, gain vs code, output compression and sample-to-antenna delay, including selected PA/switch/filter. Use actual power measurement; current setting is not output power.
calibration.tx_filter_response: Measure complex TX response and common delay together; fit FPGA correction to each actual die/board/filter state, not only nominal pole values or one cutoff scale. Hold out independent frequencies/captures and bound residual response drift against the 0.003 linear-filter error allocation. Refit delay in scheduled antenna timing when updating coefficients. Stage-frequency/Q mismatch, amplifier phase and loading belong in the measured response; no sub-percent fabrication matching is assumed. Flat IQ/DC correction alone cannot meet this obligation. The calibration response must include the actual FPGA interpolation kernel. The default short centered resampler creates a near-channel image in the diagnostic screen; a longer 40-span kernel is a candidate mitigation with 2 us lookahead that must be priced in causal response timing and FPGA resources before adoption. Provisional external complex-response measurement-error target: 0.001 relative; characterize timing/reference-plane errors separately. A 129-frequency synthetic measurement and 49-tap/12-fractional-bit refit screen supports this target for +/-5% stage mismatch, not real instrument qualification. Admission requires held-out response, native/analog peak and emitted-spectrum checks; do not admit coefficients on fit error alone.

external_frontend.isolation: Bound leakage into RX during TX and recovery after strongest TX; receiver blanking alone does not protect against damaging voltage or prolonged overload. Board enable/timing controlled by FPGA; no added die pins.
external_frontend.limits: No fabricated RF power, isolation or board latency is demonstrated by these numbers.
external_frontend.module_admission: An external PA/switch/LNA/filter module is an application-board alternative, not an assumed transparent replacement. Check usable band and all selected radio channels, RX gain/bypass loss and cascaded NF, gain/overload range, TX distortion and input power, transition timing, supply/current and FPGA control sequencing. A band-limited board must declare its subset without narrowing the chip capability inventory. Do not silently remove on-chip blocks, add pins, or credit module performance to the chip. Module power/measurement figures require the same operating point and error budget as the assembled chain.
external_frontend.pa: Qualify average OFDM output, EVM and spectral regrowth at all requested powers using actual calibrated waveform amplitude. Do not treat the initial10dB backoff allocation as sufficient: the current no-padding diagnostic passes the assigned chip-plus-PA nonlinearity screen at12dB input backoff from modeled input P1dB and fails at9dB. That memoryless model does not determine real PA backoff, absolute watts, AM/PM, memory or recovery. PA distortion is included in the combined TX budget, not added afterward.
external_frontend.selection: Matching/balun, band preselection, antenna switch and optional linear PA selected together. Loss before LNA adds directly to cascaded noise figure;2dB remains nominal fixture loss and3.5dB is the board acceptance allocation including matching/PCB margin. Candidate filter/switch data and isolation limits are documented in feasibility-gates.md; no assembled board is qualified.
external_frontend.selectivity_policy: For a fixed broad-band passive board covering the declared RF band, grant no selective rejection to blockers or DAC images inside its wanted-signal passband without a measured transfer curve. Absolute attenuation there cannot exceed the declared wanted insertion-loss ceiling while preserving that full-band board claim. A switched/tuned narrow-band board is allowed but requires its own channel coverage, settling, loss and tolerance evidence. Historical18dB selective rejection at12MHz offset is a hypothetical assistance case, not this baseline. On-chip RX selectivity/headroom and TX reconstruction remain responsible for near-channel performance.
external_frontend.turnaround_sequence: At the last valid TX sample, mute the existing RF driver and disable any external PA. Use FPGA-controlled break-before-make antenna switching; retain LO/sample clocks and required bias. Keep RX acceptance invalid until both board switching and characterized receiver overload/charge recovery have settled. Verify residual carrier/PA leakage at the RX input, not only switch control timing. Additional external RX isolation or PA output gating is permitted within the 3.5dB RX-loss allocation; no added on-chip pins or buffer memory. Longer guards are allowed only if the selected packet exchange deadline still fits. The 500ns switch allocation is not a universal total RX-recovery deadline. Budget TX tail, switching, analog recovery, RX pipeline and timing uncertainty against the earliest peer RF arrival measured from actual antenna TX end; do not borrow peer preamble time or count unproven overlap.
