tx_filter_candidate_resource_screen.compatibility: Fixed fifth-order topology; no third-order bypass selected. q_code trims paired biquad damping around Q0.618/1.618; arbitrary shapes are not qualified by the fixed Butterworth model.
tx_filter_candidate_resource_screen.gate: Selected for behavioral completion from connected power/amplitude/recovery evidence. Complete packet/mask and tolerance qualification remain open. Physical realization is deferred.
tx_filter_candidate_resource_screen.noise_current_tradeoff: Explicit real-equivalent state model at300.15K/rho10, with assigned6nV/sqrtHz integrator amplifier noise: 1pF capacitors give0.304mV RMS per-branch output noise (0.381% at80mV per-branch signal,0.761% at40mV); 2pF gives0.225mV per branch (0.281%/0.561% with the same per-branch references). At2pF, total complex noise is0.318mV; integrating only +/-10MHz gives0.215mV complex RMS,0.268%/0.537% of80/40mV complex-envelope signal RMS. Do not mix per-branch and complex reference levels. This is part of the0.8% analog noise allocation, not a new independent full-budget term. At0.25V tone peak, 2pF implies39uA largest capacitor current and99uA largest summer-resistor current. Characterize actual DAC/filter voltage scale, backoff and remaining-chain noise before selecting capacitor size. These exclude summer/CMFB/additional-state noise, flicker and real amplifier power; the4mA candidate ceiling remains unproven in hardware.
tx_filter_candidate_resource_screen.stage_order: Preferred candidate cascade: real pole, Q~0.618 biquad, Q~1.618 biquad, based on an explicit voltage-state tone screen. At rho=10, 0.25V equivalent differential input peak and1pF integrators, largest observed internal voltage is0.326V, integrator slew19.5V/us, largest capacitor current19.5uA and conservative largest summer-resistor current49.3uA. These scale with input/capacitance and exclude common-mode/summer implementation, stochastic noise and OFDM crest; they do not establish the4mA per-branch allocation.

external_frontend.tx_matching: Provide replaceable board matching components and measurement access at existing RF terminals. Select matching per assembled board/band and hold it fixed across channels; calibrate power with existing driver gain. The assigned RF-load screen favors per-board adjustment over fixed nominal matching. Its measured-loop assumption and +/-2% residual tuning error require validation. No added die pins, blocks or storage; optional external PA does not close the chip 0dBm output gate.

fpga_tx_preparation.amplitude_policy: Scale before FIR; no renormalization after correction. Joined warm-lifecycle point: requested native peak170, existing analog gain code nearest6.3. Verify waveform peaks, DAC range and power for each record.
fpga_tx_preparation.frequency_policy: Where a received waveform provides valid pilots, FPGA refines the reply frequency from received pilot evolution after successful decoding. Fall back to acquired training estimate if no usable pilot estimate exists; no injected LO truth. Waveform-specific pilot polarity and estimator statistics remain FPGA qualification obligations.
fpga_tx_preparation.initial_history: zero record prehistory with explicit guards; abort discards FPGA preparation, not chip analog history
fpga_tx_preparation.scope: External FPGA requirement, not on-chip mode/profile or fixed-point/timing qualification. The selected rational-rate polyphase interpolator uses40 input-sample span and14 fractional coefficient bits, charging2us lookahead at20MHz. Other runners explicitly use a windowed-sinc interpolation approximation and report its own delay; neither interpolation implementation is a physical chip block. Budget correction FIR delay separately.

rf_interoperability.qualification: Allocated requirements, not demonstrated silicon or router interoperability.
rf_interoperability.scope: Generic RF implementation requirements, with an external one-stream HE20 MCS0..7 client as the interoperability acceptance case. No on-chip Wi-Fi profiles, modem or CRC. Other protocol targets and existing filter settings remain selected.

tx_error_allocation.clock_source: External low-noise LO is primary qualification route; autonomous synthesis retained with separate measured/modelled spectrum. Residual phase means after permitted receiver tracking, not arbitrary phase-truth removal.
tx_error_allocation.combination: RSS only for independently justified random contributions, then add deterministic residual norms without cancellation. Correlated noise uses linear addition. Phase and supply allocations must not double count the same physical source. Spectrum, carrier leakage and unused-tone limits remain independent tests.
tx_error_allocation.converter_basis: The1.03percent converter term is an acceptance allocation, not proof from native10-bit code width. Prefer the8ENOB/0.24-amplitude behavioral integration hypothesis with7.6042dB external TX-only attenuation into the fixed PA model: whitened diagnostic converter error0.985percent and independent legacy TX/return-ACK evidence support this route. The waveform whitening is a known diagnostic mask, not complete HE scrambling. Keep9.5ENOB/0.10 as the lower-swing alternative; its4092-byte unwhitened converter error is0.851percent. Unwhitened padding causes artificial crest stress, retained as a negative control. Qualify actual complete-waveform peaks, analog swing/current, RF pad load, calibrated watts, DNL/spurs and reference noise together. Neither hypothesis is measured GF180 performance; ADC ENOB does not qualify the DAC.

tx_spectral_measurement.acceptance: Use complete actual PPDUs and calibrated antenna power, account applicable absolute and relative limits and regulatory constraints. Report insufficient burst duration or unsupported RBW/VBW as unqualified, never pass. Include emitted ramps and external PA/filter effects; document burst gating and averaging.
tx_spectral_measurement.relative_reference: Maximum signal spectral density at the same measurement settings, not integrated in-band power.
tx_spectral_measurement.scope: HE20 transmitter spectral-mask measurement contract; implementation and qualification remain open. Integrated sideband energy and steady-DATA Welch spectra cannot establish mask compliance.

rf_sample_timing.antenna_time: FPGA compensates characterized TX sample-to-antenna delay and RX antenna-to-sample delay. Nearest sample scheduling adds at most0.5/sample_hz quantization; calibration, phase drift, board switch and clock uncertainty add separately. No hardware claim of antenna-time measurement.
rf_sample_timing.board_readiness: FPGA sequences external switch/PA and admits launch only with characterized setup margin. No board-ready pad or imaginary on-chip PA sensor. Local faults override scheduled launch.
rf_sample_timing.clock: ADC/DAC sample clock; free-running throughout warm same-channel RX/TX, reset only on new sample epoch.
rf_sample_timing.host_budget: Four command frames plus wait/stage reserve:6*64 H2D words. Six RX snapshot fragments reuse ordinary IQ frames and preserve qc and payload capacity; no timestamp-induced IQ stall or added on-chip payload memory. Snapshot completion has six-frame latency on FPGA; first pair timing is retrospective.
rf_sample_timing.launch: H2D protected metadata opcode7: four consecutive metadata-only frames; each carries18descriptor bits via wc6,qc6,arg low6, with arg high2 fragment index0..3. Little-endian descriptor counter48 then epoch16 then8zero reserved bits. Normal frame sequence advances. Validate all fragments before atomic arm; no partial effect. Reject stale epoch, busy engine, target at/past current counter or forward distance>=2^47. At target require16complex pairs prefilled and local source/reference validity; missing data or readiness cancels, never launches late.
rf_sample_timing.qualification: Reference codec plus opt-in BehavioralChip uniform sample-event gate use actual finite ingress occupancy and suppress RF output before launch. Initial RX snapshot emits six IQ-carrying protected headers and preserves payload; STOP cancels launch state. Descriptor arrival is explicit caller input and must be charged by host integration. Nonuniform/delayed-RX timing providers are rejected rather than mistaken for TX sample clocks. Resnapshot after discontinuities, nonuniform converter clocks, complete exchange/RTL and physical timing remain open.
rf_sample_timing.snapshot: D2H opcode8 uses six consecutive IQ-carrying frames, each11timestamp bits: wc6 then argument low5, argument high3 fragment index0..5. qc retains ordinary IQ word count0..59. Descriptor counter48 then epoch16 then2zero reserved bits. First fragment starts fresh complex-pair packing and names its first pair; normal payload packing continues through all six fragments. FPGA retains payload while assembling descriptor. Empty first fragment forbidden. Missing/malformed fragment invalidates new mapping; no silent sample deletion. Emit at RX start/new epoch or requested resync; admit fast gain commands only after snapshot completion so status never interrupts fragments or silently exceeds its frame-latency bound. No additional metadata-only sample pause.
rf_sample_timing.storage: 48bit running counter,48bit pending target,16bit epoch,72bit fragment staging,8bit flags =192bits additional runtime state. Payload prefill uses existing1024bit ingress. No waveform templates or protocol parser.

scope: Functional analog implementation and inter-block wiring; selected values are requirements/assumptions, not measured silicon.

system_lifecycle.cold_start: Asynchronous reset/isolation dominates all outputs before any clock exists. Coarse power-on/brownout detection must not depend on the precision reference it starts. Release management only after CORE/HOST validity; enable bias/reference, qualify selected supplies/source, train host, commit complete configuration, then explicitly arm payload. Reset deassertion alone never transmits.
system_lifecycle.fault_retention: While DVDD remains valid, preserve first fault cause, subsequent-fault bitmap, configuration identity and stream/sample epochs until explicit acknowledgement. Snapshot coherently over SPI. CORE power loss invalidates all retention; cold reset must require host reinitialization rather than pretend the old epoch persists.
system_lifecycle.fpga_reset: Board reset logic asserts chip RESET_N whenever FPGA configuration or reset makes its outputs uncontrolled; CS_N has an inactive board pull and clock/data pins have defined idle states. Optional management recovery after a live host fault may preserve analog bias. Do not assume clock-loss detection catches every FPGA reset if clocks continue toggling.
system_lifecycle.hot_plug: External wired peers, pullups and clock sources can appear while inactive or unpowered. Protection handles electrical exposure; raw sensing reports attachment to FPGA policy. Contact bounce or clock pulses do not establish qualified readiness. USB VBUS and display sideband protection remain board-owned.
system_lifecycle.interrupted_configuration: Incomplete SPI words do not apply. Multiword configuration remains shadowed until validation and atomic commit. Recovery COMMIT=0 discards uncommitted recovery-mailbox fields; it cannot cancel a pending operation. On reconnect read pending/completed request identity before retrying. Active analog configuration is not reconstructed from partially written shadows.
system_lifecycle.management_clock: SPI request acceptance, recovery mailbox and fault status use SCLK plus the independent management oscillator; never REF_IN, H2D, D2H or recovered line timing. A missing target clock permits asynchronous isolation/reset assertion; synchronous reset release and target-ready acknowledgement wait for that clock. Timeout reports unavailable target without wedging management.
system_lifecycle.owner: Existing monitor, independent management oscillator and digital control; no new external pins or protocol engine.
system_lifecycle.partial_power: VDD and DVDD may arrive or disappear in either order. Analog power without digital control leaves every active output released/muted by local default hardware. Digital power without analog power allows SPI/status but not analog readiness. Board peers may drive pins while either rail is absent; all exposed pads, including host/SPI/clock pins, require power-off tolerance or board isolation. Do not assume arbitrary attached FPGA pins are fail-safe.
system_lifecycle.rearm: Read fault snapshot; remove cause; cancel/drain control operations; clear partial configuration and queues; establish new epochs; requalify affected domains; retrain host; prefill; explicitly arm. Clearing a sticky bit alone must not resume payload. Unaffected powered bias need not be cycled.
system_lifecycle.recovery_scope: Host transport fault isolates payload, cancels scheduled launches and flushes affected queues; retain valid analog bias and clocks where safe. Analog source/reference loss additionally invalidates dependent converter/CDR state and requires new qualification. Core brownout or RESET_N is a full digital reset. Never wait for an absent payload clock to mute outputs or report a fault.
system_lifecycle.status_budget: Use existing epoch_status and diagnostic allocations: live first-cause8, fault-bitmap16, configuration-id16, stream-epoch16, sample-epoch16, management-heartbeat16 and lifecycle8 =96bits; coherent SPI snapshot adds96bits. Management heartbeat is sampled by SCLK so a stalled management oscillator can be observed; it is not a calibrated frequency measurement. Cold reset clears retention and requires a fresh host session. Register mapping and CDC implementation remain open.
system_lifecycle.verification_scope: Selected whole-system requirements. RecoveryMailbox models management-clock request acceptance and shadow discard; full power/reset/CDC, hot-plug electrical behavior and RTL integration remain unqualified.

timing_review_closure.cdr: Separate acquisition, SSC tracking, residual holdover and slew terms; explicit physical frequency guardband and linear acquired-loop screen.
timing_review_closure.remaining_qualification: External source settle/noise, physical CDR and analog gain recovery, FPGA timing, real packet acquisition and canonical model/RTL integration remain open.
timing_review_closure.rf_gain: Protected atomic gain command/status, invalid sample boundary and complete feedback latency/admission with waveform-dependent settling.
timing_review_closure.scope: Four design gaps addressed; not a claim of completed full-chip behavioral/RTL implementation or physical qualification.
timing_review_closure.usb: Selected direct_stream configuration/clock guards/checker agree; BehavioralChip owns the modeled direct transport state. Framed pad/record controls do not qualify this selected path.
timing_review_closure.warm_hop: Stable host mux, bounded retune-window electrical net, sample-epoch arm/ready/ack encoding, converter isolation/reset sequence, schedule admission and source/host/supply failure policy.

unconnected_outputs_policy: Must be assigned to observation, external port or explicit no-connect before freeze is complete

video_alignment.continuous: After launch, keep serializer running from reference-derived rate and feed indexed words at exactly that average rate. FIFO underrun or source loss invalidates group; FPGA stops all lane outputs using existing controls. Group shutdown latency is bounded by FPGA observation/control path, not assumed instantaneous.
video_alignment.divider_reset: On qualified marker capture, reset word-epoch and serializer-word counters. Reset/release selected postdivider and serializer modulo10 state at the predetermined VCO phase using local falling-edge release before the nominated sampling edge; phase-qualified PLL feedback fixes which VCO cycle belongs to the reference edge. PLL itself remains running. Failure to establish phase-qualified release keeps outputs muted.
video_alignment.fpga_compensation: At group bring-up, measure/calibrate each lane fixed latency and reference/board delays. Add only positive bounded word/bit delays to earlier lanes; align all to latest calibrated lane. Maximum programmable compensation is39UI. Outside this span change board distribution or reject group, not unbounded buffering.
video_alignment.fractional_skew: No unallocated on-chip fractional delay line is assumed. Board reference fanout with per-output phase/delay adjustment and trace matching owns sub-UI static compensation. Selected residual group-skew target is0.25UI including pad/clock uncertainty, not a TMDS-compliance claim. Qualify at connector reference plane across intended narrow conditions.
video_alignment.generic_scope: Reference-synchronous launch service; no TMDS symbol parser or video protocol profile in chip. FPGA owns encoded words and lane group.
video_alignment.launch: At launch_reference_count after marker, begin first queued word with bit0; fixed serializer/pad pipeline is8lineUIs. Add selected0..3whole-word and0..9bit delays using existing bounded staging and bit counter. A missing queue word, stale epoch, missed count or lost clock cancels launch; never silently start later.
video_alignment.marker: Broadcast rising SPI_SCLK while every CS_N remains high. Board must place marker with>=2ns setup/hold around the intended common reference capture edge at every die. Marker held high>=2reference periods; one-shot edge capture prevents repeat. Any unresolved capture-edge uncertainty blocks group readiness; equal frequency alone is insufficient.
video_alignment.memory: Epoch/count/status and delay state use128bits; existing payload_staging carries at most4words per lane locally. Bulk/video frame storage remains FPGA-side.
video_alignment.observability: Report arm/marker/divider/phase/launch status and epoch through management, plus launch count. Status proves commanded sequence, not physical lane skew; independent board/connector measurement is required.
video_alignment.preparation: FPGA supplies same reference distribution and stable host clock to every die, configures stopped paths and integer ratios, waits lock/phase qualification, prefills each finite queue with training/blanking words and same first payload index, then arms each die with common epoch and launch_reference_count.
video_alignment.rx: Each receive die keeps independent CDR; FPGA uses protocol-visible training/control symbols to identify character/word index and finite per-lane deskew. TX launch alignment does not replace RX deskew. Budget up to4words external FPGA deskew for selected group; reject larger differential latency.
video_alignment.source: Use common differential forwarded word reference on REF_IN pair,74.25/1.001..148.5MHz for current video targets. Integer feedback and selected output divider produce exactly10lineUIs/reference cycle:20x then/2 at lower rates,10x then/1 at higher rates. This alignment mode does not use an independently synthesized fractional reference per die.
video_alignment.unqualified: Physical marker capture setup/hold, PLL phase-qualified reset/release, fixed8UI pipeline and connector skew require circuit/layout evidence. The mathematical model checks causal ordering and bounded compensation without assuming those are measured.

warm_hop_service.clock_loss: During armed50us retune only, expected LO absence is recorded without global fault; converters remain isolated. H2D/supply failures always fault. Source loss after qualification or expiry before readiness faults/mutes. Monitor source-loss permission is one-shot and cannot be extended by repeated arm commands.
warm_hop_service.deadline: Only arm if scheduled next air-window minus mute boundary >=50us plus separately budgeted acquisition margin. Late/missing readiness cancels that scheduled transmission, never silently sends on old channel. Protocol schedule admission remains FPGA-owned; no Bluetooth profile on chip.
warm_hop_service.epoch: Emit old-epoch end and new sample-epoch readiness before accepting new valid samples or TX. Tag queued converter blocks with epoch; reject old epoch after reset. RF payload-clock change never changes host framing epoch. FPGA resampler resets to new actual sample frequency before acknowledging readiness.
warm_hop_service.epoch_encoding: Exclusive RF protected metadata opcode6, no payload: wc bits5:0 and qc bits11:6 and argument low nibble bits15:12 carry complete16bit sample epoch. Argument high nibble phase3=H2D arm,1=D2H source/sample-ready-for-ack,2=H2D ack. Preserve normal6bit transport sequence. Reject wrong direction, phase, stale epoch or pending action. Epoch wrap requires drained queues; do not alias outstanding epoch. rf_gain_command.py supplies encoding checks. Hop acknowledgment may use up to three frame periods each direction plus100ns FPGA and six host cycles, bounded by2us.
warm_hop_service.preparation: FPGA knows next channel/time, preloads numeric frequency/dividers/gain/offset and data context through existing SPI/host controls. Only current+next context retained locally; full hop table and payload on FPGA. Stop/mute at scheduled boundary, invalidate old ADC/DAC samples and flush converter-side FIFOs through a two-domain reset handshake before releasing changed sample clock. Host framing/sequence stays continuous.
warm_hop_service.qualification: Source qualification combines externally acknowledged settled source with on-chip presence/frequency/phase observations; amplitude/phase noise are external component acceptance requirements, not inferred from frequency counting. Four microseconds is a selected observation bound, not PLL lock proof.
warm_hop_service.sample_reset: RETUNE_WINDOW gates converter clocks only after mute/CDC writer isolation. Source qualified deasserts window; release divider/ADC resets synchronously into new sample clock, then reset handshake/epoch barrier completes before payload valid. Do not reset stable host FIFOs or sequence counters.

schedule_review.ble: 150us default same-channel response uses warm direction guard, not hop. Event/channel changes use full hop budget; negotiated shorter gaps or additional Bluetooth features require explicit admission, not assumed support.
schedule_review.examples: 625us BR/EDR slots and312.5us discovery/page intervals provide scheduled gaps; ID packet68us leaves244.5us before next half-slot start. Conservative BR5-slot126us header/access+2790us maximum payload leaves209us before3125us boundary. A50us hop fits these cases with substantial margin. Packet-specific lengths and clock uncertainty still enter FPGA schedule admission; never interpret slot length alone as idle time.

warm_hop_service.scope: Selected bounded warm sequence and representative schedule admission checks; timing_services.WarmHop and hop_admission. External source/analog settling and canonical model/RTL integration remain qualification obligations, not missing sequence definitions.
warm_hop_service.selection: Frequency-hopping RF uses stable H2D-derived D2H: H2D156.25MHz,D2H78.125MHz DDR. Converter clocks remain LO-derived. Same-channel direction changes keep all clocks running. Hop changes sample epoch but never host transport clock/word alignment; no per-hop electrical host retraining.
warm_hop_service.source: Primary qualification route is a tunable external LO with preloaded next-frequency command/trigger owned by FPGA. Source must meet35us command-to-frequency/phase-noise settling budget; arbitrary fixed oscillators do not qualify. On-chip PLL may use saved bank/trim contexts only if same bound is qualified; exhaustive calibration belongs to startup, never hidden inside a hop.
warm_hop_service.timer: H2D/4 one-shot deadline atH0; maximum1953ticks=49.9968us. Independent management watchdog backs up recovery; host-clock loss cannot be masked by RETUNE_WINDOW. Repeat arm rejected until finish/reset.
